Ask.title: Apply “Like SteamOS”?
Ask.text:
The look Like SteamOS will be applied to your desktop.

What will change: colours, GTK theme, icons, cursors.

Covered by the other parts: global theme — in Plasma it is one package of the parts listed here; on this desktop Rexon applies them one by one

Partly: colours — Qt programs pick it up after you log in again

Rexon will install the programs it needs: qt6ct, breeze-icons, breeze-cursors. Your system will ask for your password.

Won't be applied: desktop shell theme — Sway has no shell theme of its own. If you use Noctalia or DankMaterialShell, press “Pass Palette to Shell” in Color Schemes after applying: they take the colours of this look

Won't be applied: desktop behaviour — it changes only things Plasma has: the Plasma splash screen after login — Sway has none of them

You can put everything back at any time with the “Put Back as It Was” button.

option.hint: Game mode adds a “Steam Big Picture” session to the login screen; choose it there yourself. On a laptop with two graphics cards the screen may stay black if Steam starts on the card the screen is not connected to. If that happens, restart the computer and choose your usual session on the login screen.
